title: Challenging level of rigid-body approach involving numerical elements (CHLORAINE) applied to repeated elastin peptides.
authors: Depenveiller, C; Wong, H; Crowet, J M; Debelle, L; Baud, S; Dauchez, M; Belloy, N
one_liner_zh: 该文针对重复弹性蛋白肽（无序序列）提出基于分子动力学聚类和刚性体近似的介观模拟方法（CHLORAINE/DURABIN），虽非直接研究PPI机制，但为IDP介导的大分子互作与组装提供了可迁移的粗粒化建模思路。
abstract: Elastic proteins and derived biomaterials contain numerous tandemly repeated peptides along their sequences, ranging from a few copies to hundreds. These repetitions are responsible for their biochemical, biological and biomechanical properties. These sequences are considered to be intrinsically disordered, and the variations in their behavior are actually mainly due to their high flexibility and lack of stable secondary structures originating from their unique amino acid sequences. Consequently, the simulation of elastic proteins and large elastomeric biomaterials using classical molecular dynamics is an important challenge. Here, we propose a novel approach that allows the application of the DURABIN protocol to repeated elastin-like peptides (r-ELPs) in a simple way. Four large r-ELPs were studied to evaluate our method, which was developed for simulating extracellular matrix proteins at the mesoscopic scale. After structure clustering applied on molecular dynamic trajectories of constitutive peptides (5-mers and 6-mers), the main conformations were used as starting points to define the corresponding primitives, further used as rigid body fragments in our program. Contributions derived from electrostatic and molecular hydrophobicity potentials were tested to evaluate their influence on the interactions during simple mesoscopic simulations. The CHLORAINE approach, despite the thinner granularity due to the size of the patterns used, was included in the DURABIN protocol and emerges as a promising way to simulate elastic macromolecular systems.
abstract_zh: 弹性蛋白及衍生生物材料沿其序列包含大量串联重复肽段，数量从几个到数百个不等。这些重复序列负责其生化、生物学和生物力学特性。这些序列被认为本质上是无序的，其行为变化实际上主要源于其高柔性和缺乏由独特氨基酸序列产生的稳定二级结构。因此，使用经典分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟弹性蛋白和大型弹性体生物材料是一项重要挑战。在此，我们提出一种新方法，能够以简单方式将DURABIN协议应用于重复弹性蛋白样肽 (repeated elastin-like peptides, r-ELPs)。我们研究了四个大型r-ELPs以评估我们的方法，该方法旨在介观尺度上模拟细胞外基质蛋白。在对组成肽段（5聚体和6聚体）的分子动力学轨迹进行结构聚类后，主要构象被用作定义相应基元的起点，随后在我们的程序中用作刚体片段。测试了来自静电和分子疏水性势能的贡献，以评估它们在简单介观模拟过程中对相互作用的影响。CHLORAINE方法，尽管由于所用模式尺寸导致粒度较粗，但被纳入DURABIN协议，并成为模拟弹性大分子系统的一种有前景的途径。
